acceptance.requirement: One tenant- and Case-owned canonical Quote aggregate.
Unknown price and cost are explicit states and never silently become zero.
Money-safe server totals are identical across registry, builder, client and print.
Package, add-on, replacement and scenario compatibility rules prevent double counting.
Catalog and vendor source versions are reproducible.
Legacy commercial data migrates without invented price facts or tenant loss.
Draft, review, publish and client decision use guarded canonical transitions.
Published QuoteVersion is immutable and remains reproducible after later versions.
Autosave and presentation never mutate or leak a published version.
Opaque client links are hash-only, expiring, revocable, rate-limited and version-scoped.
Accept and request-changes decisions are idempotent and audited.
Expired, revoked and superseded access returns safe honest states.
Version-bound print/PDF output is stable and accessible.
Tenant, role and client-link boundaries prevent cross-tenant access.
Failure UX never turns an API error into empty success.
Desktop, mobile, keyboard and 200 percent zoom gates pass.
All deterministic gates pass with skipped=0 and NOT_RUN=0.
Independent review reports P0=0 and P1=0.
Cremation and relative-burial journeys pass on exact isolated Preview SHA.
